title: fastpath: gated fast-path + precision toggle + safe-mode fallback for KV batching
author: Leah Martinez
description: Motivation: reduce tail latency and cost by aggressively using the optimized fast-path kernels for common request shapes while preserving correctness via a gated fast-path with a precision toggle and a conservative safe-mode fallback. This PR introduces: 1) fast-path gating decisions in the scheduler based on sequence length histogram and kv-cache hit probability; 2) a runtime precision toggle (fp16/bf16/int8 profiles) that flips per-request when safe; 3) safe-mode fallback path that disables optimizations when any correctness check fails; 4) KV-cache compatibility guards so cached prefixes survive precision switches; and 5) metrics and tracing hooks + perf benchmarks. Checklist: [x] scheduler gating heuristic implemented; [x] precision toggle RFC implemented; [x] safe-mode detection and fallback implemented; [x] end-to-end unit + integration tests; [x] perf benchmarks added; [x] docs/notes added. Related: ENG-1943. Context: previous fast-path rollouts caused occasional decoding mismatches under rare precision casts and subtle KV cache collisions; this change prioritizes correctness while enabling aggressive optimizations via explicit gating and a runtime safety net. Rollout plan: feature flag default-off for 1 week in canary; enable in staged clusters with perf monitoring and automatic rollback on quality/regression alerts.
